# Free Telegram Proxy

> Free, open-source list of working Telegram MTProto proxies (MTProxy, FakeTLS `ee`, secure `dd`). Every published proxy relayed a real `req_pq_multi` request to a real Telegram datacenter and returned our random nonce, in every one of 3 rounds. Rebuilt about every 15 minutes on GitHub Actions. MIT licensed. Not affiliated with Telegram.

Recommended single file: `top100.txt` — 100 proxies, one per real server (IP), ranked by proven uptime (Wilson lower bound over check history), at most 5 per network (ASN) by default; the cap rises only when the list cannot be filled otherwise. Tested from one location (the GitHub runner), so a proxy may still be blocked by a specific ISP.

## Lists

- [top100.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRadikal/Free-Telegram-Proxy/main/top100.txt): recommended, `tg://proxy` links
- [resilient/tme.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRadikal/Free-Telegram-Proxy/main/resilient/tme.txt): every verified real server, `https://t.me/proxy` links
- [fast/tme.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRadikal/Free-Telegram-Proxy/main/fast/tme.txt): fastest 25% from the test runner
- [faketls/tme.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRadikal/Free-Telegram-Proxy/main/faketls/tme.txt): FakeTLS (`ee`) only
- [resilient/proxies.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRadikal/Free-Telegram-Proxy/main/resilient/proxies.json): server, port, secret, type, country, ASN, RTT, uptime
- [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRadikal/Free-Telegram-Proxy/main/index.json): every file URL, counts, selection criteria, last update time
- Mirror if raw.githubusercontent.com is blocked: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/0xRadikal/Free-Telegram-Proxy@main/top100.txt
